[Figure 1]

In the diagram, line $l$ intersects line $m$. If $x = 50$, what is the value of $a$?
explanation: When two lines intersect, adjacent angles are supplementary (sum to $180°$). Angles $x$ and $a$ are adjacent angles at the intersection. Therefore, $x + a = 180°$. Given $x = 50°$, we have $50° + a = 180°$, so $a = 130°$.
